[last] Yes—for this dev-server instance. Every tab connects to the same fixed pane, which allows one active worker session. Opening another tab invalidates the previous one; that tab can still show old content while requests fail.

Native app panes have separate sessions, so this isn’t a one-tab restriction for the whole app.

Use one tab on port 5173 for now. The stale tab should explain what happened instead of silently looking broken.
